text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Bwahaha!!
Trainer, what a morning! It shines like the smile of Apollo!!
choice_data_list: Good morning, you're in high spirits, huh—
Good morning, you're in high spirits, aren't you—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Gimlet-senpai~!!
You were sooooo incredible yesterday, right?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Like jumping in on street gigs...
Or casually shaking cocktails in the dorm♪

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that look on your face...
Are you curious about a fairy's afternoon?
If you wish, I could reenact it for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tanino Gimlet had such a fulfilling day off that people are talking about it!
